en.description:
Adds a dedicated in-game radar window that scans all animals across the map, neatly organized into tabs by species.

Features:
1. Dedicated Toolbar Button: Click the 'Animal Radar' button on the top-left main toolbar to toggle the window.
2. Species Tab Navigation: Dynamic tabs grouped by species (Deer, Brown Bear, Fox, Wolf, Birds, Fish Schools, etc.) showing counts and entity lists.
3. Instant Camera Jump: Click 'Focus' on any entry to move your camera directly to the animal.
4. Great for 'Animal Lover' Achievement: Effortlessly track down all animal species across the entire map, making it ideal for completing the 'Animal Lover' achievement.
en.name: Animal Radar
en.summary: In-game radar window to view all animals across the map grouped by species with instant camera tracking

zh.description:
在遊戲中新增專屬動物雷達視窗，即時掃描地圖上的動物，並按照物種分頁分類整理。

功能特色：
1. 專屬工具列按鈕：點擊畫面左上角主工具列的「動物雷達」按鈕即可開啟或關閉雷達視窗。
2. 物種分頁標籤：自動按地圖上的動物種類（如鹿、棕熊、狐狸、狼、鶴群、魚群等）建立分頁標籤，輕鬆查看各物種數量與實體清單。
3. 一鍵鏡頭跳轉：點擊列表中的「觀察聚焦」，鏡頭立即瞬移至該動物身旁。
4. 解鎖成就得力助手：輕鬆掌握全地圖所有動物蹤跡與物種清單，對於達成「動物愛好者」成就非常有幫助。
zh.name: 動物雷達
zh.summary: 在遊戲中提供動物雷達視窗，按物種分頁檢視全地圖動物並一鍵跳轉鏡頭觀察
